Keep every row in order. Preserve all [[I]], [[B]], [[SC]] emphasis markers, [[Nnumber]] note markers and explicit source line counts. Do not return hashes; the host binds immutable hashes.", "context": {"title": "Notre-Dame de Paris", "unit": 51, "heading": "I\nGRINGOIRE A PLUSIEURS BONNES IDÉES DE SUITE RUE DES BERNARDINS", "previous_rows": [{"source_id": "fr86-u051-b0126", "target": "—Да, — продолжал Гренгуар, разговаривая сам с собой и касаясь носа указательным пальцем в знак размышления, — вот оно! — Бродяги — славные ребята. — Египетское племя её любит. — Они поднимутся по первому слову. — Нет ничего проще. — Дружный натиск. — Воспользовавшись беспорядком, её легко похитят. — Уже завтра вечером… они ничего лучшего не пожелают.", "source_sha256": "ab959ebadd94953630c2714d99db37a26bc47bfd92937f4913a0a94b3deb8d09", "target_id": "ru-fr86-u051-b0126", "tag": "p", "target_sha256": "f6848d6679b9269728d7368c696c89cc497b603cc9d503d2ba43fab18c838f8b"}, {"source_id": "fr86-u051-b0127", "target": "—Средство! Говори, — сказал священник, тряся его.", "source_sha256": "83d2d327e0ada32048085eaf8ff7cfdec2a9651aee1db0927a520545a820c835", "target_id": "ru-fr86-u051-b0127", "tag": "p", "target_sha256": "37d6e94995498af167dcc52b446202ff5fffb8e40a8a1346e472068ddff30217"}], "source_language": "French", "part": null, "book": 10, "chapter": 1, "role": "CHAPTER"}, "source_rows": [{"id": "fr86-u051-b0128", "text": "Gringoire se tourna majestueusement vers lui: «Laissez-moi donc! vous voyez bien que je compose.» Il réfléchit encore quelques instants. Puis il se mit à battre des mains à sa pensée en criant: «Admirable! réussite sûre!", "sha256": "5be7db871ac8311d104743cb94d413381566c23e92483d3844b188a5c63886a2", "role": "paragraph", "tag": "p", "source_physical_indices": [3073], "source_xml_sha256": "b4926d012bf6e9c29d81fa6f82138162f902346a47923171a92c3a7c26f3fdca", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr86-u051-b0129", "text": "—Le moyen!» reprit Claude en colère.", "sha256": "adb313c7dce1dd4396c56d41dd1b6800a4e5a4a0bda93b443984ffb39b7a9e50", "role": "paragraph", "tag": "p", "source_physical_indices": [3074], "source_xml_sha256": "33ba91ea26224624437f5678d7b0dfc8523d1cf63ee5c9975d2e2c9b2e22b3fb", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr86-u051-b0130", "text": "Gringoire était radieux.", "sha256": "d073a75b31dda7e99aa9ba3476a4f76cfd54bf2c700f456a319d5fedce82d55b", "role": "paragraph", "tag": "p", "source_physical_indices": [3075], "source_xml_sha256": "2062daff94234809dc81276556ce182643da52171e0a643b71a5bff0d8e2fcf1", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr86-u051-b0131", "text": "«Venez, que je vous dise cela tout bas. C'est une contre-mine vraiment gaillarde et qui nous tire tous d'affaire. Pardieu! il faut convenir que je ne suis pas un imbécile.»", "sha256": "5118ae0e5a4839d63e2196b5133b46a957f0ddb7267885c332457fcb06e70532", "role": "paragraph", "tag": "p", "source_physical_indices": [3076], "source_xml_sha256": "c04458e5e64078cc2182412b3ff45715b7988f18f54a1d7798fb7e48efc8d899", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr86-u051-b0132", "text": "Il s'interrompit: «Ah çà! la petite chèvre est-elle avec la fille?", "sha256": "67a31ea008e9f6e18b091793437269d038f75b0dc5b7db36244a3e0138a42a2a", "role": "paragraph", "tag": "p", "source_physical_indices": [3077], "source_xml_sha256": "ce7c02d439253c29416fe9d426854df23f7046b405b8aa9423541aa4b7db89c6", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr86-u051-b0133", "text": "—Oui. Que le diable t'emporte!", "sha256": "3f0f097e527e80ac870853545957ecf548be485012590d47777312bebebc2bd9", "role": "paragraph", "tag": "p", "source_physical_indices": [3078], "source_xml_sha256": "fab80fc403087767cdd4f4e7e4631abb739c18218c1ded7080f134b19d65e89b", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr86-u051-b0134", "text": "—C'est qu'ils l'auraient pendue aussi, n'est-ce pas?", "sha256": "9ef593a55e796dddb2fd827fdf9bbc45feab493359fcb2f73657d034e6cc06a0", "role": "paragraph", "tag": "p", "source_physical_indices": [3079], "source_xml_sha256": "ca38331f972502c9d2badc7e4ae5c856688945dcab3289d38d8889f32487e572", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr86-u051-b0135", "text": "—Qu'est-ce que cela me fait?", "sha256": "09dae04a8577a65f9a6e71905ba2dbb246f3c1d38e83f871fa4e157ff0c2afe8", "role": "paragraph", "tag": "p", "source_physical_indices": [3080], "source_xml_sha256": "67713ec2ff66f663f5df0cf97a5fa3114a70a179ef6e83666c46d3900a2198ec", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr86-u051-b0136", "text": "—Oui, ils l'auraient pendue. Ils ont bien pendu une truie le mois passé. Le bourrel aime cela. Il mange la bête après. Pendre ma jolie Djali! Pauvre petit agneau!", "sha256": "0248f311f6a79a23e9ff9883a3a8f9e6df29128d1b6170f9f520717374351728", "role": "paragraph", "tag": "p", "source_physical_indices": [3081], "source_xml_sha256": "9de568c44a4d6aafa874be1ab3332fa17c3a1a2033db341d41cb5cc0902dd81a", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr86-u051-b0137", "text": "—Malédiction! s'écria dom Claude. Le bourreau, c'est toi. Quel moyen de salut as-tu donc trouvé, drôle? faudra-t-il t'accoucher ton idée avec le forceps?", "sha256": "149f19c4daf863c176b675f6cb9361979a1fbd8d3caef5da51f9ca905abda85c", "role": "paragraph", "tag": "p", "source_physical_indices": [3082], "source_xml_sha256": "dced8dc32b921dbed882729b9103af87ef87d4201a534908f769ce2c62c747e5", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr86-u051-b0138", "text": "—Tout beau, maître! voici.»", "sha256": "5620e1082aee6c1b2b2ff23434ef51d5992f8f8f8ec77d46705f4a111fdc00da", "role": "paragraph", "tag": "p", "source_physical_indices": [3083], "source_xml_sha256": "333bd75c5ed66d4072882ed3b35b0fa97097626ff02ed563d1c8d53b5ebb04c2", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr86-u051-b0139", "text": "Gringoire se pencha à l'oreille de l'archidiacre et lui parla très bas, en jetant un regard inquiet d'un bout à l'autre de la rue où il ne passait pourtant personne. Quand il eut fini, dom Claude lui prit la main et lui dit froidement: «C'est bon. À demain.", "sha256": "32f7c0be151a11827a193302247a607dd2fea489e3a22560f130139d81965504", "role": "paragraph", "tag": "p", "source_physical_indices": [3084], "source_xml_sha256": "d71680d00c343de77033673da610f0145544cbb2502670378841b128a5263391", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr86-u051-b0140", "text": "—À demain», répéta Gringoire. Et tandis que l'archidiacre s'éloignait d'un côté, il s'en alla de l'autre en se disant à demi-voix: «Voilà une fière affaire, monsieur Pierre Gringoire. N'importe. Il n'est pas dit, parce qu'on est petit, qu'on s'effraiera d'une grande entreprise. Biton porta un grand taureau sur ses épaules; les hochequeues, les fauvettes et les traquets traversent l'océan.»", "sha256": "65b3aa7c2c3cd98f8256eb9d8e55d6731cfd2cf4e62216f4ce81494997770b07", "role": "paragraph", "tag": "p", "source_physical_indices": [3085], "source_xml_sha256": "5de611db6f50b1c7185931c49292a1bb74355f5302aa6ee8a7ff6349f3b29965", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}]}
